highlights.headline: Why the global electrification agenda misses the point on Africa’s energy crisis
highlights.summary: With hundreds of millions of Africans still lacking electricity access, global electrification goals must reflect the continent’s realities and deliver development alongside connections The post Why the global electrification agenda misses the point on Africa’s energy crisis appeared first on Climate Home News.

highlights.headline: Commission enhances energy efficiency and sustainability of data centres in the EU
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 21 Sep 2026 The European Commission proposed today a common rating scheme for data centres aimed at increasing transparency on their energy use and supporting their sustainable integration into Europe's energy system.

highlights.headline: Germany faces energy tax losses as EV sales rise
highlights.summary: The rapid shift to electric vehicles in Germany is cutting fuel tax revenue for the government. As EV sales surge, policymakers face growing pressure to find new ways to fund roads and transportation infrastructure.
